snippet.title: Terminator: Arena 3.0 (Definitive Edition) Release Trailer
snippet.description:
After years of development and feedback, Terminator: Arena has reached 3.0, this is the final and definitive update. Includes 2 player classes, the Terminator and the human resistance. 22 maps, custom bots, and full weapon replacers.


https://www.moddb.com/mods/terminator-arena/downloads/terminator-arena-30-definitive-edition
